verdict.rationale: Automatic suppression is a fair question for an email marketing platform, but the evidence pack never mentions unsubscribe handling, bounce suppression, spam-complaint processing, or CAN-SPAM/GDPR compliance defaults. The pricing and homepage items cover trials, dedicated IPs, transactional emails, templates and automation, none of which addresses this story. The community items concern the ending of the free plan and are off-topic.

support.subject: As an ops user, unsubscribes, bounces, and spam complaints are suppressed automatically and honored across every send type — CAN-SPAM/GDPR hygiene by default
